provenance.purpose: Exploratory observable raw-channel-MSE risk screen, not selection or a confirmatory test.
provenance.score: Negative favors candidate. -2/(P*N*K) Re sum conj((Ga-Gb)S) * (Z^2-|B+(Ga+Gb)S/2|^2-sigma2) / conj(B).
provenance.scale: Unnormalized coefficient Frobenius squared-error difference divided only by known N*K=96; no true-channel energy or NMSE normalization.
provenance.assumptions: The population identity requires independent proper Gaussian heldout pilot columns with identity covariance, independent proper complex noise, and nonzero known B.
provenance.caveat: These reused exploratory banks were accepted with a full39-pilot rank check; formal heldout independence is not claimed. Fresh confirmation must generate nine independent heldout pilots after fitting-context acceptance.
provenance.candidate_scope: All candidates use context30 only. No heldout score, true channel, or path-count input enters any prediction.
provenance.objective: Mean pairwise risk versus fixed current correction after strict four-incumbent, each-regime upper95 guards; no0.001 band. Pairwise finite scores need not be transitive.
provenance.bootstrap: Exact existing4000 multinomial384 count vectors per regime shared over every bin/candidate/incumbent.
provenance.storage: Every per-fit/per-anchor candidate-versus-four-incumbent score retained. Mean/CI/failed constraints included for every candidate.
